content:
# Comstar overlay MCP — AO catalog metadata + COMSTAR tunnel bootstrap fields.
# Reach OverlayPacker does not read this file; ComstarMcpBootstrap / mcp_yaml.dart does.
# Session MCP id becomes client.google_workspace via tunnel://session-mcp/google_workspace.
id: google_workspace
description: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) via Reach stdio tunnel
capabilities: >
  Gmail list/search/read/send; Calendar list calendars/events + create event;
  Drive list/search/read/get + create/update/move/share/delete/doc;
  get_user_email. Tool playbooks: calendar_voice, gmail_voice, drive_voice skills.
good_for: calendar, gmail, drive, google workspace, email, schedule, files
planner_hint: Attach for Google account questions when the resident is linked.
user_goal_keywords:
  - calendar
  - gmail
  - drive
  - google
  - inbox
  - meeting
  - email
  - schedule
  - files
  - documents

# COMSTAR bridge bootstrap (not AO stdio/streamable_http)
transport: stdio_tunnel
alias: google_workspace
npx_package: mcp-server-google-workspace@0.2.6
env_from:
  - GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
  - GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
  - GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN
requires_tokens: true
guest_allowed: false
